Now I have a thorough understanding of the codebase. Let me summarize my findings and present the options.

---

## Summary

The task is to make the Avalonia design-time previewer render real queue cards instead of garbage, by: (1) adding a `DesignData` static class with pre-populated view models, (2) extracting the card `DataTemplate` into `TaskCard.axaml` and the bottom footer into `QueueFooter.axaml`, (3) wiring `Design.*` attributes, and (4) updating two test classes that parse `QueuePanel.axaml` by path.

**Key observations from reading the code:**

| Finding | Detail |
|---|---|
| `QueuePanel.axaml` (284 lines) is 16 lines below the 300-line `FileSizeGuard` limit — no room for design attributes | ~82 lines are the card `DataTemplate` body, ~83 lines are the two footer `Border`s |
| `MainWindow.axaml` has `<Design.DataContext><vm:MainWindowViewModel/></Design.DataContext>` but `Tasks` is empty → blank preview | Need to point at populated `DesignData.Main` |
| `ShowHfGate` is `_keyStatesLoaded && !IsHuggingFaceConfigured` | At design-time keys never load → ShowHfGate=false → the status strip shows, not the HF gate |
| `OnSelectedTaskChanged` fires `SelectTaskAsync` which reads disk → must NOT set `Main.SelectedTask` in DesignData | Row-level `IsSelected=true` drives all selected-state visuals without disk I/O |
| `RecordStageCompleted` is `internal` — DesignData lives in the same assembly so it compiles | `MarkRunning`, `IsSelected`, `RunningElapsedLabel` are public or internal |
| `ContrastTests` uses `LoadQueuePanel()` which reads `QueuePanel.axaml` by path — after extraction, `Assert.NotEmpty` would see zero text elements | Must extend to scan `TaskCard.axaml` and `QueueFooter.axaml` too |
| `StatusFooterFlyoutTests` uses `queuePanel.FindControl<CommonButton>("StatusExpandButton")` — after extraction, `StatusExpandButton` lives in `QueueFooter`'s namescope | Must resolve `QueueFooter` first, then `FindControl` on it |
| `TaskCardThemeGuardTests` scans `QueuePanel.axaml` for `x:Name="TaskQueueList"` line containing `ItemContainerTheme` | That line stays in QueuePanel.axaml, unchanged |
| `TaskCardRenderTests` walks the visual tree from MainWindow | Extraction doesn't change visual tree structure, tests pass unmodified |
